description: This file defines the GuidId class, a unique identifier based on Guid, including methods for creation, comparison, serialization, and caching.

classes.name: GuidId
classes.description: A sealed class representing a unique identifier based on Guid, supporting comparison, equality, serialization, and caching.

methods.name: GetNewGuidId
methods.description: Generates and returns a new random GuidId instance.

methods.name: GetGuidId
methods.description: Returns a GuidId instance corresponding to the provided Guid.

methods.name: FindOrCreateGuidId
methods.description: Finds or creates a GuidId instance for the given Guid, utilizing an intern cache.

methods.name: CompareTo
methods.description: Compares this GuidId with another for ordering.

methods.name: Equals
methods.description: Checks if this GuidId is equal to another.

methods.name: GetHashCode
methods.description: Returns the hash code for this GuidId.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the underlying Guid.
